| [Handover and adoption](SKILL.md) | Agent Skill | Close a use case properly — run the handover to the plant against its definition of done, confirm real adoption rather than delivery, and act on the gap between implemented and productive. Covers the three-question handover test, the utilization expectation, what to do about an asset nobody opens, and handing over the function itself rather than a single use case. Use when a use case is being handed to a plant, when someone asks whether something is actually in use, when utilization is low or `NEVER`, or when a role or portfolio is changing hands. Also covers the OD x IT ownership rules (build-and-run, ownership moves only on formal acceptance, the handover checklist, recurring self-assessment), the impact evaluation and adoption confirmation record of a live use case (formerly od-impact-evaluation) and the utilization review "deployed is not used" per site (formerly od-utilization-review). |
